The Source on Instagram: "Swae Lee’s Coachella performance came to an abrupt and frustrating end after organizers appeared to cut the lights while he was still on stage—signaling his set time had run out.

According to footage and reports, the moment caught Swae off guard, with the artist visibly bothered as the music and lighting were shut down. He reportedly pleaded with production to let him continue, specifically asking to perform fan-favorite hits like “This Could Be Us” and “Black Beatles.”

Despite his efforts, the set was ultimately ended, leaving fans disappointed and the moment quickly going viral online.

Festival schedules are known to run on strict timing, but the abrupt cutoff sparked debate among fans—many feeling the situation could have been handled differently given the energy of the performance. 🛑

#SwaeLee #Coachella #FestivalNews #Trending #LiveMusic"
